description: Bite-sized molded chocolate pieces (~8g each), ideal for snacking and gifting.

flavourDescriptions.Fruit & Nuts: Indulge in a royal fusion of rich, premium dark chocolate and traditional warmth. Our Fruit & Nut Bites feature hand-selected almonds and cashews gently fried to golden perfection in pure desi ghee, paired with sweet, juicy raisins. Each 8-gram heart and flower piece delivers a delightful crunch, followed by a smooth, velvety dark chocolate finish that melts in your mouth.

name: Berry Blue

description: An exquisite fusion of succulent wild blueberries with velvety artisan chocolate. Available in handcrafted Mini Bars, Bites, and full chocolate Bars (50g, 100g, 150g, 200g).

description: Golden caramelized butterscotch crunch embedded in rich artisanal chocolate with delicate heart textures. Launching soon in all bars (50g, 100g, 150g, 200g), mini bars, and bites!

name: Paan Special Bites
label: Special Flavour
description: Experience the nostalgic, refreshing burst of traditional Indian paan reimagined in luxurious chocolate. Infused with aromatic paan flavour essence and studded with crunchy, vibrant Colorful Mukhwas, every 8-gram heart and flower bite delivers a delightful burst of aromatic sweetness followed by a smooth, melting finish. The ultimate post-meal indulgence rolled into one.

name: Midnight Orange Bites
label: Special Flavour
description: Awaken your senses with Canberrys Almond Premium Orange Dark Chocolate. Each 8-gram masterpiece marries the deep, intense notes of premium dark chocolate with a refreshing citrus burst of sun-ripened orange. Studded with crunchy almonds and artisanal texture, these heart and flower bites offer a luxurious balance of bitter, sweet, and zesty perfection in every single bite.

name: Manna Chocolate Gift Pack
description: Curated selection of handcrafted Manna chocolates in our signature keepsake combo tub and premium gift boxes.
